#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the release binary ./app from the AArch64 assembly sources.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
clang -arch arm64 -O2 -Wall -o app src/main.s src/eval.s
strip app 2>/dev/null || true

// eval.s — evaluate one calc expression (see SPEC.md).
//
// The parser is an iterative operator-precedence (shunting-yard style)
// evaluator with explicit stacks, so arbitrarily deep nesting such as
// "((((...))))" cannot overflow the machine stack.  It alternates between two
// states:
//
//   expect_operand:  NUMBER | '-' (unary, pushed as OP_NEG) | '('
//   expect_operator: '+' '-' '*' '/' '%' | ')' | end of line
//
// Before an operator of precedence P is pushed, every stacked operator with
// precedence >= P is applied (left associativity; unary minus binds tightest).
// '(' has precedence 0, so it acts as a barrier for every reduction.
//
// C prototype:
//   uint64_t eval_line(const char *p, const char *end,
//                      int64_t *vstack, uint8_t *ostack);
//   returns x0 = EVAL_OK / EVAL_ERROR / EVAL_BLANK, x1 = value when EVAL_OK
//
// Both stacks must hold at least (end - p + 1) entries.
// Leaf function: touches only x0-x15 and the flags.

        .equ    EVAL_OK,        0
        .equ    EVAL_ERROR,     1
        .equ    EVAL_BLANK,     2

        // Operator codes stored on the operator stack (index into prec_table).
        .equ    OP_LPAREN,      0
        .equ    OP_ADD,         1
        .equ    OP_SUB,         2
        .equ    OP_MUL,         3
        .equ    OP_DIV,         4
        .equ    OP_MOD,         5
        .equ    OP_NEG,         6

        // What to do once a reduction loop finishes.
        .equ    K_BINARY,       0       // push the pending binary operator
        .equ    K_RPAREN,       1       // pop the matching '('
        .equ    K_EOL,          2       // finish the line

        .section __TEXT,__const
prec_table:
        .byte   0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3     // ( + - * / % neg

        .text
        .globl  _eval_line
        .p2align 2
// Register map:
//   x0  cursor            x1  line end
//   x2  value stack base  x3  operator stack base
//   x4  value stack top   x5  operator stack top   (both: next free slot)
//   x6  current byte      x7/x8 operands (a, b)    x9 result
//   x10 pending opcode    x11 minimum precedence   x12 continuation kind
//   x13 stacked opcode    x14 its precedence       x15 &prec_table
//   x16 literal limit (INT64_MAX / 10)
_eval_line:
        mov     x4, x2
        mov     x5, x3
        adrp    x15, prec_table@PAGE
        add     x15, x15, prec_table@PAGEOFF
        mov     x16, #0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC
        lsr     x16, x16, #4            // 0x0CCC...C = 922337203685477580

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- operand
expect_operand:
        cmp     x0, x1
        b.hs    operand_eol
        ldrb    w6, [x0], #1
        cmp     w6, #' '
        b.eq    expect_operand
        cmp     w6, #'\t'
        b.eq    expect_operand
        sub     w7, w6, #'0'
        cmp     w7, #9
        b.ls    number
        cmp     w6, #'-'
        b.eq    push_neg
        cmp     w6, #'('
        b.ne    fail
        mov     w9, #OP_LPAREN
        strb    w9, [x5], #1
        b       expect_operand

push_neg:
        mov     w9, #OP_NEG
        strb    w9, [x5], #1
        b       expect_operand

operand_eol:
        // Nothing at all on the line means blank; otherwise an operand is missing.
        cmp     x4, x2
        ccmp    x5, x3, #0, eq
        b.ne    fail
        mov     x0, #EVAL_BLANK
        ret

// x7 holds the first digit; accumulate the rest with overflow detection.
number:
        cmp     x0, x1
        b.hs    number_done
        ldrb    w6, [x0]
        sub     w9, w6, #'0'
        cmp     w9, #9
        b.hi    number_done
        add     x0, x0, #1
        cmp     x7, x16
        b.hi    fail                    // x7 * 10 would exceed INT64_MAX
        add     x7, x7, x7, lsl #2      // x7 *= 5
        add     x7, x9, x7, lsl #1      // x7 = x7 * 2 + digit
        tbnz    x7, #63, fail           // > INT64_MAX
        b       number
number_done:
        str     x7, [x4], #8

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- operator
expect_operator:
        cmp     x0, x1
        b.hs    operator_eol
        ldrb    w6, [x0], #1
        cmp     w6, #' '
        b.eq    expect_operator
        cmp     w6, #'\t'
        b.eq    expect_operator
        cmp     w6, #')'
        b.eq    close_paren
        mov     w10, #OP_ADD
        cmp     w6, #'+'
        b.eq    binary
        mov     w10, #OP_SUB
        cmp     w6, #'-'
        b.eq    binary
        mov     w10, #OP_MUL
        cmp     w6, #'*'
        b.eq    binary
        mov     w10, #OP_DIV
        cmp     w6, #'/'
        b.eq    binary
        mov     w10, #OP_MOD
        cmp     w6, #'%'
        b.ne    fail
binary:
        ldrb    w11, [x15, w10, uxtw]
        mov     w12, #K_BINARY
        b       reduce
close_paren:
        mov     w11, #1                 // everything except '('
        mov     w12, #K_RPAREN
        b       reduce
operator_eol:
        mov     w11, #1
        mov     w12, #K_EOL

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- reduce
// Apply stacked operators while their precedence is >= w11.
reduce:
        cmp     x5, x3
        b.eq    reduce_done
        ldrb    w13, [x5, #-1]
        ldrb    w14, [x15, w13, uxtw]
        cmp     w14, w11
        b.lo    reduce_done
        sub     x5, x5, #1
        ldr     x8, [x4, #-8]!          // pop right operand (or the negand)
        cmp     w13, #OP_NEG
        b.eq    apply_neg
        ldr     x7, [x4, #-8]           // left operand; result replaces it
        cmp     w13, #OP_SUB
        b.lo    apply_add
        b.eq    apply_sub
        cmp     w13, #OP_DIV
        b.lo    apply_mul
        b.eq    apply_div

apply_mod:
        cbz     x8, fail
        sdiv    x9, x7, x8              // INT64_MIN / -1 yields INT64_MIN ...
        msub    x9, x9, x8, x7          // ... so the remainder is correctly 0
        b       store_result
apply_add:
        adds    x9, x7, x8
        b.vs    fail
        b       store_result
apply_sub:
        subs    x9, x7, x8
        b.vs    fail
        b       store_result
apply_mul:
        mul     x9, x7, x8
        smulh   x6, x7, x8
        cmp     x6, x9, asr #63         // high half must be the sign extension
        b.ne    fail
        b       store_result
apply_div:
        cbz     x8, fail
        cmn     x8, #1
        b.eq    apply_div_neg1
        sdiv    x9, x7, x8
        b       store_result
apply_div_neg1:
        negs    x9, x7                  // overflows only for INT64_MIN
        b.vs    fail
store_result:
        str     x9, [x4, #-8]
        b       reduce

apply_neg:
        negs    x9, x8
        b.vs    fail
        str     x9, [x4], #8
        b       reduce

reduce_done:
        cmp     w12, #K_RPAREN
        b.lo    push_binary
        b.eq    pop_paren
        // K_EOL: only an unmatched '(' can remain.
        cmp     x5, x3
        b.ne    fail
        ldr     x1, [x2]
        mov     x0, #EVAL_OK
        ret

push_binary:
        strb    w10, [x5], #1
        b       expect_operand

pop_paren:
        cmp     x5, x3                  // no '(' to match
        b.eq    fail
        sub     x5, x5, #1
        b       expect_operator

fail:
        mov     x0, #EVAL_ERROR
        ret

// main.s — calc driver: read stdin, evaluate each line, print results.
//
// All of standard input is slurped into one heap buffer, then split on '\n'
// with memchr.  Each line is handed to eval_line (eval.s) together with a pair
// of scratch stacks sized to the line.  Output is accumulated in a static
// buffer and flushed with write(2).

        .equ    EVAL_OK,        0
        .equ    EVAL_ERROR,     1

        .equ    STDIN,          0
        .equ    STDOUT,         1
        .equ    STDERR,         2
        .equ    EINTR,          4

        .equ    READ_CHUNK,     65536           // initial input capacity
        .equ    OUT_SIZE,       65536
        .equ    OUT_SLACK,      32              // >= longest record ("-9223372036854775808\n")
        .equ    MIN_STACK,      256             // minimum stack capacity (entries)
        .equ    ENTRY_BYTES,    9               // 8-byte value + 1-byte operator

        .zerofill __DATA, __bss, outbuf, OUT_SIZE, 4

        .section __TEXT,__cstring
msg_nomem:
        .asciz  "calc: out of memory\n"
        .equ    MSG_NOMEM_LEN, 20

        .section __TEXT,__const
        .p2align 3
str_error:
        .ascii  "error\n\0\0"               // padded to 8 bytes for a single load

        .text
        .globl  _main
        .p2align 2
// Register map:
//   x19 input cursor        x20 input end          x21 value stack
//   x22 operator stack      x23 stack capacity     x24 output buffer base
//   x25 output cursor       x26 current line end   x27 input buffer
//   x28 output flush threshold
//   [sp, #0..31]            integer formatting scratch
_main:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-96]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        stp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        stp     x27, x28, [sp, #80]
        sub     sp, sp, #32

        bl      read_all
        mov     x27, x0
        mov     x19, x0
        add     x20, x0, x1
        mov     x21, xzr
        mov     x22, xzr
        mov     x23, xzr
        adrp    x24, outbuf@PAGE
        add     x24, x24, outbuf@PAGEOFF
        mov     x25, x24
        mov     x28, #(OUT_SIZE - OUT_SLACK)
        add     x28, x24, x28

line_loop:
        cmp     x19, x20
        b.hs    finish

        // Locate the end of this line (or of the input).
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     w1, #'\n'
        sub     x2, x20, x19
        bl      _memchr
        cmp     x0, #0
        csel    x26, x20, x0, eq

        // Ensure the scratch stacks hold (line length + 1) entries.
        sub     x0, x26, x19
        add     x0, x0, #1
        cmp     x23, x0
        b.hs    stacks_ready
        lsl     x1, x23, #1
        cmp     x1, x0
        csel    x0, x1, x0, hi
        mov     x1, #MIN_STACK
        cmp     x0, x1
        csel    x23, x0, x1, hi
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, #ENTRY_BYTES
        mul     x0, x23, x0
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, out_of_memory
        mov     x21, x0
        add     x22, x0, x23, lsl #3

stacks_ready:
        // Keep room for one full record in the output buffer.
        cmp     x25, x28
        b.ls    1f
        mov     x0, x24
        sub     x1, x25, x24
        bl      write_all
        mov     x25, x24
1:
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x26
        mov     x2, x21
        mov     x3, x22
        bl      _eval_line
        add     x19, x26, #1
        cmp     x0, #EVAL_ERROR
        b.lo    emit_value
        b.hi    line_loop                   // blank line: no output

        adrp    x9, str_error@PAGE
        add     x9, x9, str_error@PAGEOFF
        ldr     x9, [x9]
        str     x9, [x25]
        add     x25, x25, #6
        b       line_loop

// x1 = value.  Digits are produced backwards into the scratch area, then copied.
emit_value:
        tbz     x1, #63, 1f
        mov     w9, #'-'
        strb    w9, [x25], #1
        neg     x1, x1                      // as unsigned, exact even for INT64_MIN
1:
        add     x11, sp, #32                // end of scratch
        mov     x10, x11
        mov     x12, #10
2:
        udiv    x13, x1, x12
        msub    x14, x13, x12, x1
        add     w14, w14, #'0'
        strb    w14, [x10, #-1]!
        mov     x1, x13
        cbnz    x1, 2b
3:
        ldrb    w14, [x10], #1
        strb    w14, [x25], #1
        cmp     x10, x11
        b.lo    3b
        mov     w9, #'\n'
        strb    w9, [x25], #1
        b       line_loop

finish:
        mov     x0, x24
        sub     x1, x25, x24
        bl      write_all
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, x27
        bl      _free
        mov     w0, #0

        add     sp, sp, #32
        ldp     x27, x28, [sp, #80]
        ldp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #96
        ret

// Fatal allocation failure: report on stderr and exit(1).
out_of_memory:
        mov     x0, #STDERR
        adrp    x1, msg_nomem@PAGE
        add     x1, x1, msg_nomem@PAGEOFF
        mov     x2, #MSG_NOMEM_LEN
        bl      _write
        mov     w0, #1
        bl      _exit

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// read_all() -> x0 = buffer, x1 = length
// Reads standard input to EOF into a growing heap buffer.
        .p2align 2
read_all:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]

        mov     x20, xzr                    // length
        mov     x21, #READ_CHUNK            // capacity
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, out_of_memory
        mov     x19, x0

read_loop:
        cmp     x20, x21
        b.lo    1f
        lsl     x21, x21, #1
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x21
        bl      _realloc
        cbz     x0, out_of_memory
        mov     x19, x0
1:
        mov     x0, #STDIN
        add     x1, x19, x20
        sub     x2, x21, x20
        bl      _read
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.gt    read_more
        b.eq    read_done
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w0, [x0]
        cmp     w0, #EINTR
        b.eq    read_loop
        b       read_done                   // treat other errors as EOF
read_more:
        add     x20, x20, x0
        b       read_loop

read_done:
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// write_all(x0 = buffer, x1 = length)
// Writes the whole buffer to stdout, retrying short writes and EINTR.
        .p2align 2
write_all:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1

write_loop:
        cbz     x20, write_done
        mov     x0, #STDOUT
        mov     x1, x19
        mov     x2, x20
        bl      _write
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.lt    write_failed
        add     x19, x19, x0
        sub     x20, x20, x0
        b       write_loop
write_failed:
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w0, [x0]
        cmp     w0, #EINTR
        b.eq    write_loop
write_done:
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32
        ret
